oracle_provenance: Standard, foundational FMEA Risk Priority Number method (AIAG-VDA FMEA handbook); independently hand-verified before implementation. Not copied from any shared Skill fixture.
scope: Bounded FMEA RPN arithmetic against a declared maximum acceptable value; not a cross-functional team consensus verification.

cases.question: Does RPN=120 (8x5x3) clear a 150 maximum threshold?
Does the maximum possible RPN of 1000 (10x10x10) correctly exceed a 500 acceptance threshold?
Must a severity rating of 0 (outside the 1-10 scale) be rejected rather than silently used?
Does the minimum possible RPN of 1 (1x1x1) correctly pass any reasonable threshold, the model's own lower-bound self-consistency check?
